title: Multimodal synthesis of MRI and tabular data with diffusion in a joint latent space via cross-attention
abstract: arXiv:2605.06699v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We propose a multimodal latent diffusion model that jointly synthesizes volumetric magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and tabular clinical data within a shared latent space via cross-attention. This approach enables coherent joint representation learning of MRI and tabular modalities for generative modeling. Our model utilizes a variational autoencoder to fuse the two modalities before diffusion-based synthesis, allowing modality-appropriate reconstruction with separate decoders for MRI and tabular data. We evaluated the framework on data from the German National Cohort (NAKO Gesundheitsstudie), comprising over 10,000 participants with MRI scans and clinical tabular features such as age, sex, body measurements, and ethnicity. The generated MRI volumes exhibited anatomical plausibility and body composition consistent with the synthesized tabular attributes. Quantitative evaluation using Fr\'echet distance and precision-recall metr

translated_title: 通过交叉注意力在联合潜在空间中使用扩散模型进行MRI与表格数据的多模态合成
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种多模态潜在扩散模型，通过交叉注意力在共享潜在空间中联合合成体积磁共振成像（MRI）和表格临床数据。该方法能够实现MRI和表格模态的连贯联合表示学习，用于生成建模。我们的模型利用变分自编码器在基于扩散的合成之前融合两种模态，并通过针对MRI和表格数据的独立解码器实现适合各模态的重建。我们在德国国家队列（NAKO Gesundheitsstudie）的数据上评估了该框架，该数据包含超过10,000名参与者的MRI扫描以及年龄、性别、身体测量和种族等临床表格特征。生成的MRI体积表现出解剖学上的合理性，且其身体成分与合成的表格属性保持一致。使用Fréchet距离和精确率-召回率指标的定量评估验证了该方法的性能。
tldr: 提出了一种基于交叉注意力的多模态潜在扩散模型，能够在共享潜在空间中联合合成MRI体积图像和表格临床数据，生成的MRI具有解剖学合理性且与表格属性保持一致。
en_tdlr: A cross-attention-based multimodal latent diffusion model that jointly synthesizes MRI volumes and tabular clinical data in a shared latent space, producing anatomically plausible MRIs consistent with the generated tabular attributes.
